description: Capture, annotate, combine, and record screen regions
pre_install: if ($global) { throw 'Snitt uses a per-user desktop session. Install without --global.' }
notes: Snitt starts at login. Press Ctrl+Print Screen, then drag a region. Press V in the picker to record video.
Before updating: finish the current session, then run Install-Scoop.ps1 again.
Private GitHub release; install and update with Install-Scoop.ps1 using your own gh authentication.
